note: Trader-level guide: individual stalls at London's markets and food halls, never the markets themselves (those are best-street-food-london and best-london-markets). Sit-down restaurants inside market buildings are out of scope. Only sources dated 2023 or later count, because stall line-ups turn over. The trader checklist is the market_traders table in the Supabase project (edaiinwgjnqdthjanmrd); its market_traders_ranked.sources column counts citations from EVERY topic and must not be printed here.
